factual_methodology.summary: 9 October Treasury curve from official U.S. Treasury; IPCA from 9 October IBGE reporting relayed by public broadcaster/B3; B3 9 October official exchange close; AP Brent and S&P closes; BLS 14/15 October release calendar. Saturday has no asserted market session.

novelty.summary: Moves from 9 October morning's pending IPCA and Thursday auction relief to observed September inflation composition, Friday Treasury reversal and Friday equity close.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Contiguous economic argument, conditional scenarios, explicit market/inflation/forecast separation, no investment recommendations, seven linked source resources per locale.

contextual_depth.summary: Distinguishes temporary utility rebate level effect from inflation persistence, separates IPCA group contributions from subcategory electricity, notes debt cost transmission and importer/exporter distribution.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 1 evidence table + 2 same-unit bar charts + 1 causal flow + 1 regional map in both EN/PT-BR
visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Group IPCA contributions in percentage points, Treasury tenors in percent, matched values, region and flow captions conditional.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: IPCA group contributions must not be added to the electricity subcategory; AP market settlements separate from official statistics.

contrary_evidence: Electricity rebate expiry mechanically explains a large fraction of September's month-on-month headline but may not repeat.
Improved shipping or fuel deliveries can reduce secondary cost pressures without reversing prior price-level changes.
An equity rally may reflect earnings expectations unrelated to household real income.
limitations: Only published 9 October closes and releases; no 10 October market trading prices.
IPCA breakdown relies on 9 October IBGE reporting reproduced by Agência Brasil and B3.
U.S. CPI due 14 October and PPI 15 October are not represented as already published.
Brent settlement reported by AP is not the EIA forecast and is not a retail fuel price.
notes: Manual consistency review of link parity, visual-unit integrity, time cutoffs and numeric labels; CI validation and public rendering follow publication.

en.title: Global Macro — Brazil's inflation surprise meets a rebound in U.S. bond yields
en.deck: Brazil's September IPCA reached 0.82% as the Itaipu rebate reversed; equities rose even while U.S. Treasury yields and oil kept financing and living costs elevated.
en.regime: Equity-index gains coexist with above-target Brazilian 12-month inflation, elevated U.S. long yields and uncertain energy costs.
en.key_risk: Temporary electricity-bill effects turn into broader persistent inflation as expensive financing amplifies the pressure.

pt-BR.title: Macro Global — surpresa do IPCA brasileiro encontra nova alta dos juros americanos
pt-BR.deck: O IPCA de setembro avançou 0,82% após o fim do desconto de Itaipu; bolsas subiram apesar dos juros americanos elevados e dos riscos de energia e financiamento.
pt-BR.regime: Altas dos índices acionários coexistem com inflação brasileira em 12 meses acima do teto da banda, juros longos americanos elevados e custos energéticos incertos.
pt-BR.key_risk: Choque temporário de energia se dissemina para inflação persistente, agravada pelo financiamento caro.
